text: 港股收盘，恒生指数涨0.44%，恒生科技指数涨1.08%。恒指港股通ETF银华（159318）跌0.08%，港股通科技ETF鹏华（159751）涨0.65%。板块方面，广播、其他能源储存运输板块涨幅靠前；油品石化贸易、非金属矿开采Ⅲ板块跌幅靠前。个股方面，芯德半导体涨28.38%，旺山旺水-B涨17.46%，白鸽在线涨17.2%，天数智芯涨15.49%，MOMENTA-W涨14.35%；海丰国际跌7.83%，登临科技-P跌7.79%，创新实业跌6.28%，中远海能跌5.51%，中国铝业跌4.91%。
text_en: Hong Kong stocks closed with the Hang Seng Index up 0.44% and the Hang Seng Tech Index up 1.08%. The Hang Seng Stock Connect ETF Yinhua (159318) fell 0.08%, and the Stock Connect Technology ETF Penghua (159751) rose 0.65%. By sector, broadcasting and other energy storage and transportation sectors led gains, while oil products and petrochemicals trading and non-metallic mineral mining III led declines. Among individual stocks, Xinde Semiconductor rose 28.38%, Wangshan Wangshui-B gained 17.46%, Baige Online rose 17.2%, Tianshu Zhixin gained 15.49%, and MOMENTA-W rose 14.35%; SITC fell 7.83%, Denglin Technology-P dropped 7.79%, Chuangxin Industrial fell 6.28%, COSCO Shipping Energy dropped 5.51%, and Aluminum Corporation of China fell 4.91%.
